cause_quote: The introducing diff filtered runtime selection on `entry["isAvailable"]` and raised `No available watchOS runtime` when the filter found no match, before the new creation-time repair could run.
user_saw: The screenshot job finished the iPhone and iPad captures, then stopped without producing the Apple Watch screenshot.
summary: The shared Watch screenshot lane now gives CI one runtime repair attempt if runtime selection or simulator creation reports an unavailable runtime.
reasoning: I checked the introducing diff and its parent: the parent selected from available Watch devices and had no runtime repair, while #176958 added repair only after a `runtime path not found` error during simulator creation. The reported run stopped during runtime selection, so it hit a gap that existed from the first version of the recovery feature. The PR leaves the underlying reason for the runtime becoming unavailable unproven.
